sentences.en: She is in her element when it comes to tennis.
Color is the most sacred element of all visible things.
sentences.zh: 颜色是所有可见事物中最神圣的要素。

sentences.en: Nature is a very important element in the Australian culture.
sentences.zh: 自然在澳大利亚文化中非常重要。

senses.zh: 基本部分，要素；元素；有点，少量；一群人；恶劣天气（the elements）；基本原理；适宜的环境；电热元件，电热丝；（基督教圣餐中的）面包和酒
